observed_issue: Stage track colors did not change when the active phase advanced in the San browser page.
root_cause: The San s-for declaration did not bind a loop index, while its class expression referenced index.

fix.after: s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"
fix.scope: Only the loop declaration was changed; Vue source and formal_30_v1 artifacts were not modified.

manual_check.expected: Click the advance button and verify that reached colors update cumulatively with the active phase.
